title: Cajun Tofu, Cheddar & Spinach Salad with Scallion-Yogurt Dressing

steps.text: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
While the grill pan heats up, trim green onions and place on a plate. Drizzle with oil and season with salt.
Once the grill pan is hot, add the green onions. Cook, turning once, until tender and lightly charred, about 5 minutes; return to the plate.

Meanwhile, place yogurt, oil, water, vinegar, and spices in a small bowl; whisk to combine the dressing and set aside. (Add additional water, a few teaspoons at a time, if necessary, to reach a drizzling consistency.)
Place spices in another small bowl and stir to combine the spice mix.
Cut the tofu planks in half, then cut each half into 2 triangles; place on another plate. Season with the spice mix on both sides.
Once the green onions are done, return grill pan to medium-high heat and coat with oil. Add tofu and grill, flipping once, until charred and warmed through, 5-7 minutes. Return to the plate.
Meanwhile, mince the grilled onions add to the bowl with the dressing. Stir to combine and set aside. (Reserve plate for next step.)
Coarsely grate cheese and place on the reserved plate.
Halve tomatoes and add to the plate with the cheese.
Halve and pit the avocados; scoop out with a spoon and medium dice the flesh. Add to the plate.
Divide spinach between plates or bowls; top with cheese, tomatoes, avocado, and tofu. Serve with dressing on the side and enjoy!
